subject: Shortcase Snippet and Badge Authorization for Website Promo
summary: Request from ByteBridge to publish a 2-line customer blurb and partner badge on Redwood website with localized translations; internal marketing/legal review and final signed consent attached.
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@bytebridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Customer blurb + badge for Redwood homepage — permission request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — our product and marketing teams were impressed by the latency numbers on the demo traces. We'd love to highlight ByteBridge as a short customer mention on your homepage and include the Redwood partner badge in our partner page.

Specifically we're asking for:
- Permission to publish this short 18-word blurb on the Redwood website: "ByteBridge reduced inference cost by 42% using Redwood Dedicated."
- Use of the ByteBridge logo (web and retina) and permission to host one small company badge on the page.
- Permission to translate the blurb into FR and DE for EU-localized pages.

I've attached a draft release (client-quote-draft.docx) and can sign whatever format you need. Can you confirm if we need a different legal wording or any restrictions on asset use? We hope to go live the week of May 17.

Thanks,
Nina
Nina Patel
Head of Partnerships, ByteBridge
Nina.Patel@bytebridge.com
+44 20 7123 4567

Attachment: client-quote-draft.docx (word doc, draft release)

Forwarding Nina's note — ByteBridge wants a short blurb + our partner badge on their site and wants localized translations. Target go-live next week.

Vanessa — can marketing confirm the text and badge guidelines (and share the badge package we use)?
Markus — please review the draft release and let us know if the wording Nina proposes is acceptable or if legal wants a short addendum about usage duration and logo treatment.

If possible, I'd like to keep the blurb to ~18 words and avoid any metrics we haven't jointly validated. Nina, I'm looping you in — we'll come back with a signed consent once legal approves.

Thanks,
Olga

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Customer blurb + badge for Redwood homepage — permission request

Thanks for the ping. Quick thoughts from marketing:

1) Proposed public blurb (marketing-approved, 18 words):
"ByteBridge cut LLM inference unit costs by 42% while meeting production latency SLOs with Redwood Dedicated."

2) Badge use: fine with the standard partner badge; we'll provide 1x PNG and 1x SVG. See badge guidance here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cByteBridgeAssets and attached PDF (redwood-badge-guidelines.pdf).

3) Localization: fine to translate the approved blurb into FR/DE. Please request translated copy from ByteBridge for review before publishing.

4) Timeline: If legal signs off by EOD Wednesday, marketing can prepare assets and go live May 18.

Markus — flag any legal redlines below and we can send a single combined release for Nina to sign.

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Writer, Redwood Marketing
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: redwood-badge-guidelines.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@bytebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Customer blurb + badge for Redwood homepage — permission request

Thanks — reviewed the draft. Legal is comfortable with the proposed 18-word blurb so long as we get:
- A countersigned release that grants Redwood non-exclusive, worldwide rights to use the blurb and ByteBridge logo for marketing in perpetuity, with an option for ByteBridge to request removal with 30 days' notice.
- Confirmation that the numeric claim (42% cost reduction) is joint-approved; if ByteBridge prefers a more general line (e.g., "significant reduction in unit cost") we can accept that.

I drafted a short release and attached a DocuSign link; Nina, if you can countersign the DocuSign or return a signed PDF we'll be good to proceed. I'll also attach the marked-up release template for transparency.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-marked-release.docx (legal draft)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@bytebridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer blurb + badge for Redwood homepage — permission request

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. ByteBridge is happy to proceed with the exact 18-word blurb Vanessa proposed (we've validated the cost figure internally and are comfortable including it):
"ByteBridge cut LLM inference unit costs by 42% while meeting production latency SLOs with Redwood Dedicated."

I've signed the DocuSign and attached the executed release (bytebridge-signed-release.pdf). ByteBridge also confirms:
- We grant Redwood the rights described in the release (non-exclusive, worldwide; removal on 30 days' notice).
- Approved to translate the blurb into FR and DE — we'll send translated strings to Vanessa by Friday.
- You may use our logo and a small company headshot (attached in the Drive folder linked above).

Please confirm when the assets are published and we'll amplify the page on our channels.

Cheers,
Nina
Nina Patel
Head of Partnerships, ByteBridge
